title: Finding the old Coda article: Loren Schoenberg and Lewis Porter
summary: Brief talk about who might locate the Coda magazine article.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: You might have it somewhere in the – but it’s probably in the library at Hamilton.
A lot of places have DownBeats and that’s about it. A lot of that stuff is – but there’s a lot of people – you’re probably in touch with Loren Schoenberg.
He, I bet he’s one. He can find – if anybody can find it he can.
Or Phil Schaap but he’s gone.
Yeah, yeah. My old buddy who wrote a book on Lester Young, and wrote a book on Coltrane – Lewis Porter. He could find that I bet.
